worldcombat.skill.mindreader.summary: Read the foe's next move: your accuracy is maxed and the foe is revealed, so the next hit will not go wide; the read is spent on the strike.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.0: Max your aim before the foe slips away
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.1: Light up a target hiding behind cover
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.2: Set up a hit that must land
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.description: The read raises your accuracy to %1$s stages and stays for %2$s.
The target is revealed for %1$s and stays visible through cover.
Read range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s. Single target and needs line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.predict.on: Predict: a longer read, longer reveal and more light, but windup costs %1$s more and cooldown grows to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.predict.off: Quick read: a shorter read and reveal and a shorter cooldown, good for maxing your aim often.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On, the read lasts longer and reaches further: window x1.6, reveal x1.4 and more light, but a longer windup and cooldown; off keeps them short for frequent quick reads.
The companion only reads while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller reads at point-blank, larger approaches to read.
When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from leaving its post to read.
